change: the cyber quiz is premium in both places on the Command Center, teacher document and student link, and the free Unit 1 preview keeps everything else
_context: Tanner, 2026-09-08: 'Just lock the quiz all together. Student and teacher.
Free preview is fine with just the slides and other supplementals.'
The page gates lesson materials on `unlocked`, which is
STATE.entitled || unitFree(u). Unit 1 is a free unit, so `unlocked` is TRUE
for a signed-out visitor and the quiz was published to them in two places:
the teacher quiz document in the materials row, and the student quiz link in
the pages row. Both now read STATE.entitled through one predicate, quizOpen(),
which the answer key already used.
NOTHING ELSE IN A FREE UNIT MOVES, and that is half of what the checks are
for. The deck, guided notes, supplements, teacher guide, lesson page,
scenarios, terminal lab and Question of the Day stay exactly as they were. A
mutation that locks the whole row instead of the quiz has to go red, because
'lock the quiz' and 'lock the preview' are one careless line apart.
WHAT THIS IS: presentation gating, on two of the three surfaces, and the
distinction is worth keeping straight. The Drive quiz document is shared
'anyone with the link' and the student quiz page is a public Shopify page, so
hiding both stops them being PUBLISHED to a visitor who has not paid, and does
not revoke a URL somebody already holds. The answer key is different in kind:
the server refuses it on a credential. Making the student quiz page itself
refuse an unentitled reader is board 258 and 276, not a Command Center edit.
NO LIVE CHECK IS POSSIBLE FROM HERE, and that is a property of the change
rather than an omission. This PR touches no route and no runtime module, so
merging deploys nothing: the change reaches a teacher only when the Matrixify
sheet is imported, which is a human action. The live assertion to run after
that import is written in the run note rather than pretended to here.

checks.name: the quiz is locked in both places and nothing else in a free unit is
the key endpoint is unchanged by this pass
the teacher quiz DOCUMENT rides on the free-unit gate again
checks._why: This is the state the page ships in today. matButton takes `unlocked`, which is true for a signed-out visitor on Unit 1, so the Drive quiz url is printed into public HTML. Section 9 renders the materials row in exactly that state and must go red.

checks.name: the student quiz LINK rides on the free-unit gate again
checks._why: The other half of 'student and teacher'. A gate that only covered the teacher document would leave the quiz a click away in the row below it.

checks.name: quizOpen stops meaning entitled
checks._why: One predicate feeds all three surfaces, so it is the single point where this whole change can be undone by accident.

checks.name: THE ONE THAT OVERSHOOTS: locking the quiz locks the whole free preview
checks._why: 'Lock the quiz' and 'lock the preview' are one careless line apart, and the overshoot is the more damaging of the two because it takes away the thing the free unit exists to show. Tanner asked for the preview to keep the slides and supplementals, so section 9 asserts each of them is still OPEN and this must go red.

checks.name: the sheet re-read as a CSV rebuilds the page it was generated from, byte for byte
checks._why: Generation is not evidence that generation worked. This one now undoes FOUR line edits rather than two, each listed explicitly rather than matched by a loose regex, so an edit the verifier does not know about fails the comparison instead of being normalized away. It also asserts no destination other than quiz was narrowed, which is the overshoot above checked from the artifact side.

checks.name: the crosswalk still agrees with the CED taxonomy after the regeneration
checks._why: The gate narrowing must not have disturbed which bank each row's key points at. Same two independent methods as the first pass.
